title: Intel / INTC down 22.90% After hours today - October 29, 2026
gist: Intel stock fell about 22.9% after hours on a weak Q4 forecast (EPS guide of $0.25 versus $0.43 expected) and a warning that the PC market will keep shrinking through at least 1H 2027, plus an Israel plant disruption.

insights.claim: Intel shares fell 22.90% after hours on October 29, 2026 after it guided Q4 revenue lower and earnings of 25 cents per share versus 43 cents expected by analysts.
insights.speaker: T
insights.so_what: Large guidance-driven gap down; watch whether the sell-off overshoots given strong data center demand.

insights.claim: Intel expects PC market units to fall a further 10% in 2027 after a 12% decline in 2026, with the downturn persisting through at least the first half of 2027.
insights.speaker: T
insights.so_what: Client-exposed names face a prolonged unit decline; do not assume a 2027 PC recovery.
insights.locator: Intel warned that the PC market downturn

insights.claim: Soaring memory chip prices are cited as the cause of weak PC demand, linking the DRAM price spike to client-computing weakness.
insights.speaker: T
insights.so_what: Memory tightness benefits memory vendors but squeezes PC OEMs and CPU vendors.
insights.locator: as soaring memory chip prices continue to weigh on demand

insights.claim: CEO Lip-Bu Tan said Intel's data center business would have performed more strongly without raw material shortages and a factory shutdown in Israel.
insights.speaker: T
insights.so_what: Data center upside was supply-limited, so revenue deferral rather than demand loss.
insights.locator: Chief executive officer Lip-Bu Tan said

insights.claim: Intel estimates the Israel manufacturing disruption will cut revenue by about $600 million over two quarters, with full financial impact uncertain.
insights.speaker: T
insights.so_what: Quantifies a near-term headwind; uncertainty means risk of further revision.

insights.claim: A deadly explosion at Intel's Kiryat Gat facility in Israel earlier in October killed two and seriously injured another, per local media cited by Reuters.
insights.speaker: T
insights.so_what: Operational and safety event behind the output loss; watch restart timing.
insights.locator: This comes after a deadly explosion
